name: apollo
description: Apollo.io: people and organization search, person and company enrichment (credits), contacts, accounts and sequences; agent bulk enrichment and contact writes need opt-ins, sequence enrolment and webhook enrichment are node only

nodes.title: Search people
nodes.description: People API Search over Apollo's database by title, seniority, location and employer filters (no credits; returns names, titles and employers but no emails or phones; use enrich_person for those)

person_seniorities.description: owner, founder, c_suite, partner, vp, head, director, manager, senior, entry, intern

contact_email_status.description: verified, unverified, likely to engage, unavailable

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, to get the next page

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.description: Call any Apollo.io API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/contact_stages". Only the API's own host is allowed. Agent tools may only read paths under /contacts, /contact_stages, /accounts, /account_stages, /email_accounts, /emailer_campaigns, /labels, /users, /auth/health.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/contact_stages"
